title: First look of my multiplayer PvP game
author: dreamswedontshare
selftext:
Disclaimer: most (80%+ easily) of the coding was done by Claude, but there's no AI generated visuals or audio in the project, everything is bought/free to use, or made in Blender by me, by reshaping bought assets.

Hey guys! 

We've been working on this project for a month now, and I wanted to share a little trailer of a previous version (0.8.0, while the current project is on 0.9.5).

TL;DR: it's a — first and foremost — multiplayer pvp battleground where you fight in third person while controlling a battalion of units in various game modes like 3v3, FFA, Capture the Flag or, as of the latest update, Siege.

The game is very much inspired by Mount & Blade, with a similar Single Player campaign coming, too. However, the main focus is currently Multiplayer that's similar to M&B Bannerlord's Captain mode. 

You queue up or create lobbies, and fight it out on one of 10+ maps, choosing between 9 factions (so far) and over 50 unit types.

One distinct feature from Captain is the Command View, where the camera rises up to an RTS view, and you can command your units in a strategic fashion.

Main game mode is 3v3, but we've just created Siege with a plethora of siege engines and fully destructible castles, which is pretty fun, and there are other game modes as well, and we plan both PvE game modes and a Single Player campaign as well.

Progression is similar to most online pvp games. You have coat of arms and commander customization, matches grant you silver that you can use to buy new cosmetic pieces, emotes, armor finishes, weapon trails, and other things.

There are quests, leaderboards, achievements (2 of which I don't even know how to get), and a Creator mode where you can do massive, 300 vs 300 battles offline.

It's coming to Steam soon, Multiplayer will be free to play, while the upcoming Single Player mode will be a cheap, paid DLC.

Let me know what you guys think!
